So much I could say about this app… I’ve come across a lot of apps over the years that were meant to help people overcome addiction, but many were lacking in many areas, and I didn’t even understand why until I came across Quittr. 

For starters, for what Quittr offers, it has to be among the most if not THE most reasonably priced platform of its kind. A lot of apps in this realm (in my opinion) have their pricing as more of an obstacle to people looking to overcome addiction than an aid. 

Much of the challenge I’ve had in the past of trying to overcome addiction is just not having the help or resources in the heat of the moment. Quittr provides super practical aids to literally go to when you’re in a rough moment. You also have simple and easy access to tons of people JUST LIKE YOU who are on their journey. This was also significant for me, because I’ve been in groups in the past where I just didn’t see much representation of my age demographic, and that felt very isolating. With Quittr, it genuinely is a best of a community feel as I feel you can get in an app these days.

I could also mention the learning resources, games, metrics, and MUCH more. This app is literally an answered prayer. Yes, I have my own motivations for staying clean, but Quittr has been a HUUUUGE boost for me along my journey… I’m 25 days clean, and though a long journey awaits, I’m extremely hopeful and optimistic, in large part because of the resource I have in Quittr.
